graph.title: LEGO Creator 5761 Mini Digger (model 1: wheel loader)
notes: Low confidence: the booklet is low-resolution pictures. Stud positions, some piece identities and the build order are inferred from the parts list and the final model images, so the ports are approximate.

Only model 1 (the wheel-loader digger, pages 2-9) is built. The booklet's quad-with-crane (pages 10-16) and buggy (pages 17-22) reuse the same 57 pieces. Each piece is one node, so those models are not built separately.

The earlier graph left b56 (third 3176 plate) and b57 (Technic pin 4274) with no edges. I could not see either used in model 1. They are now attached to the digger so it is one connected build. b56 sits on the free stud b27 stud.2.4, and b57 is inserted through b56's hole and into the arm b46. Their real positions are uncertain.

Assumptions: the rear wheel holder b2 sits under the 2x4 plate b1, and the front holder b18 sits under sub-assembly b17/b19. The orange round plates b3/b4 are spacers under the rear bracket b5. The two tail lights b15/b16 are pushed onto the bracket's vertical face.

The loader arms (b46/b47, 4735) clip onto the bar of b45 at the cab front and onto the bar of the bucket's handle plates b37/b38. The bucket is built from b37/b38, b39, b40/b41 and panels b42/b43/b44.
Each tyre is joined to its wheel with a single edge and no ports, because the tyre has no ports in the catalogue.
